name: The birthday letter
description: A warm, five-chapter birthday letter: a welcome, the year behind you, a photo wall, a timeline of moments, sealed notes for later, and a surprise at the end.
tagline: Everything you'd want to say on their birthday

defaults.title: Happy birthday
defaults.openingMessage: Before you scroll — this took a while to make, and every bit of it is true.
defaults.closingMessage: Here's to another year of you. I'm glad I get to watch it happen.

copy.envelope.title: It's your birthday.
copy.envelope.subtitle: And I didn't want to just send a text.
copy.welcome.subtitle: Take your time with this one.
copy.closing.title: Here's to another year of you.
copy.surprise.intro: One last thing, and then I'll let you go.

content.text:
I could have sent a message this morning like everyone else. But there are things that don't fit in a message, and this year I wanted to say them properly.

So: happy birthday. Scroll slowly.
Write about their year here — the thing they were nervous about and did anyway, the thing that didn't work out, the way they handled it. Be specific. Specific is what makes it land.
Replace this with something they actually said this year that you never forgot.

content.caption: Tap any photo to see it properly.

content.text: For the days that need it
These are sealed. Open one when the label fits — not before.

memories.title: The day we met
memories.description: Replace this with what actually happened. The small details are the ones worth keeping.

memories.title: That trip
memories.description: Where you went, what went wrong, why it's still the story you tell.

memories.title: The hard year
memories.description: The one you got through. Worth naming — it's part of the story too.

memories.title: Last birthday
memories.description: What you did, and what's changed since.

openWhen.label: you need to hear something good
openWhen.content: Replace this with the thing you'd say if they called you at 2am feeling small. Say it plainly.

openWhen.label: you can't sleep
openWhen.content: Something quiet. A memory that doesn't ask anything of them.

openWhen.label: you're proud of yourself
openWhen.content: Tell them you saw it too. People rarely get told this one.

openWhen.label: you miss me
openWhen.content: The one to write last, when you know what you actually want to say.

futureLetter.title: Read this on your next birthday
futureLetter.content: Write this one to the person they'll be in a year. Guess at what they'll have been through. Being wrong is fine — being there is the point.

finalSurprise.question: Same time next year?
finalSurprise.successMessage: Good. I'll start making the next one.
